_doc: Every kind of thing a pinned stream body carries, per dialect, and what lm15 does with it (changes/2026-11-05-stream-final-copy.md).

tools/check_stream_events.py fails when a pinned stream body carries a kind this table does not list: a new event type, delta type, part key or chunk key is a decision, made here, before a case pins it.

status: 'read' = lm15 maps what it carries (as says to what); 'duplicate' = it restates content lm15 reads elsewhere (of says where), so reading it too would count that content twice; 'ignored' = it carries nothing a Response holds (why says so), or a fact a rule withholds (why names the rule); 'gap' = it carries content the complete path reads and the stream path drops, an open INV-051 difference (why says which), and a pinned body that carries it fails the tool.
role (Responses only, MAP-20): 'fragment' = a piece of a value the item's final copy restates; 'final-copy' = the per-item restatement a reader completes fragments from.

Kinds: responses = the event's type, and type:item.type for output_item events; anthropic = the event's type, and type:block-or-delta type; chat = chunk.<key>, choice.<key> and delta.<key> for keys with a non-null value; gemini = chunk.<key>, candidate.<key> and part.<key>.
A row whose kind no pinned body carries is documented behaviour the corpus does not pin; the tool lists those rows without failing.

response.queued.why: a status (background mode): the response so far, no content

response.in_progress.why: restates the response so far, which has no output yet

response.output_item.added:function_call.as: ToolCallDelta: call id, name, and any arguments it already carries

response.output_item.added:message.why: opens a message item; its text arrives as output_text.delta fragments and in the item's final copy

response.output_item.added:reasoning.as: an empty ThinkingDelta: a reasoning item is a thinking part even with no visible summary (MAP-7.9)

response.output_item.done:function_call.as: the call's arguments the fragments did not deliver, with its id and name (MAP-20)

response.output_item.done:message.as: the message text (output_text and refusal contents, in order) the fragments did not deliver (MAP-20)

response.output_item.done:reasoning.as: the summary text (parts joined with a newline) the fragments did not deliver (MAP-20), then the item's id and encrypted_content as ContinuationDelta (MAP-7 rule 8)

response.content_part.added.why: opens a content part; its text arrives as fragments and in the item's final copy

response.content_part.done.of: response.output_item.done:message (MAP-20 reads the final copy once, per item)

response.output_text.delta.as: TextDelta, with the fragment's token logprobs

response.refusal.delta.as: TextDelta (no RefusalDelta exists: a streamed refusal is text, a stated INV-051 difference)

response.function_call_arguments.done.of: response.output_item.done:function_call (MAP-20; the Codex backend sends parallel calls' arguments only in these two)

response.reasoning_summary_part.added.why: opens a summary part; the reader joins parts with a newline before the first fragment of each later part (summary_index)

response.reasoning_text.delta.as: ThinkingDelta (reasoning content; the complete path reads only the summary, a stated INV-051 difference)

response.metadata.why: the Codex backend's moderation metadata about the turn, no content

response.completed.as: StreamEndEvent (finish reason, usage, provider_data); its output is the final copy of the whole response, which the harness's final-copy check reads (INV-051)

response.incomplete.as: StreamEndEvent: the finish reason from status and incomplete_details, as on the complete path (length for the output limit), and usage; the final copy of the whole response, like response.completed

response.failed.of: error (OpenAI sends an error event, then response.failed with the same error: receipts/2026-11-05-stream-final-copy/openai)

content_block_start:text.as: opens a text part (any text it carries is the first fragment)

content_block_start:redacted_thinking.as: a thinking part whose data rides as continuation

content_block_delta:signature_delta.as: the thinking block's signature, as continuation

content_block_stop.why: closes a block; it restates nothing (Anthropic sends no final copy)

chunk.id.why: withheld on the stream path (MAP-9 rule 6, MAP-9.6)

chunk.created.why: a timestamp no Response field holds

chunk.model.why: withheld on the stream path (MAP-9.6: a chunk's model may be the dated snapshot)

chunk.service_tier.why: billing metadata no Response field holds

chunk.routing.why: router metadata (which backend served the chunk)

chunk.prompt_filter_results.why: Azure content-filter annotations on the prompt; a filtered answer is reported by finish_reason

choice.index.why: lm15 reads choices[0] (one choice per request)

choice.content_filter_results.why: Azure content-filter annotations; a filtered answer is reported by finish_reason

choice.matched_stop.why: SGLang: the stop token id that ended the turn (finish_reason says it stopped)

choice.stop_reason.why: vLLM-style servers: the stop token id (finish_reason says it stopped)

choice.seed.why: the sampling seed the server used

chunk.modelVersion.why: the stream keeps the request's model (MAP-4)

chunk.responseId.why: withheld on the stream path (MAP-9.6: Gemini's stream Response carries no id)

chunk.createTime.why: a timestamp no Response field holds

candidate.finishMessage.as: the message of the error a refused candidate raises (finishReason SAFETY and the like); otherwise prose explaining the finish reason

candidate.index.why: lm15 reads candidates[0] (one candidate per request)

candidate.groundingMetadata.why: the complete path reads it as citations (CitationPart); the stream path does not read it. No pinned stream carries it; open (changes/2026-11-05-stream-final-copy.md)

part.text.as: TextDelta, or ThinkingDelta when the part is a thought

part.thought.as: marks the part's text as thinking

part.functionCall.as: a whole ToolCallDelta (Gemini sends each call whole)

provenance.evidence: each row read from the reference's stream mapping (lm15-python lm15/providers/openai.py, anthropic.py, openai_chat.py, gemini.py at the commit that implements MAP-20) and, for every seen row, from the pinned bodies that carry it (tools/check_stream_events.py lists them); changes/2026-11-05-stream-final-copy.md
